title: Security Deposit Account Balance Owed: Due Date, Guarantee Claims, Write-Offs and Collections
content:
**Due date and payment.** A balance owed on a Security Deposit Account is due the program's due period in calendar days after the statement date. It may be paid by any lease instrument.

**Guarantee claim.** On a Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan account, a balance owed still unpaid the program's claim waiting period after its due date is claimed from the guarantee. Whatever the claim does not cover stays owed.

*Retired clause.* The words by which the guarantee "pays the smaller of the unpaid balance and the coverage (the program's coverage multiple times the monthly rent at move-in)" are **no longer in force**. They are superseded by the current basis for the guarantee coverage.

**Small balances.** A balance owed at or below the program's small-balance write-off amount, once due, is written off by a small-balance write-off credit.

**Referral to collections (time condition).** A balance may be referred to collections only after the balance owed due date plus the program's referral period. Collections days are counted as calendar days, starting the day after the due date. The referral may be made from the last counted day. The due date and the balance owed are read from the account's own record.

**What a referral takes.** A referral takes the balance owed. When the program refers ledgers together with the balance owed, it also takes the ledger balances left on the statement.

**Closing.** The account closes when the deposit held and the balance owed are both 0.00. This can happen after the refund; after a payment, a claim or a write-off; or when the collection agency reports the balance resolved.

### Referral boundary (hypothetical dates, 30-day referral period)

| Due date | Last counted day | Referral on the day before | Referral on the last counted day |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 April | 10 May | not yet permitted | permitted |
| 1 November | 1 December | not yet permitted | permitted |

### Write-off boundary (hypothetical, write-off amount 25.00 USD)

| Balance owed once due | Result |
|---|---|
| 25.00 USD | written off by a small-balance write-off credit |
| 25.01 USD | not written off; it stays owed and may be referred when the period has run |

**Closing illustration (hypothetical).** The deposit held is 0.00 after application, and the 60.00 USD balance owed is paid in full. Both are then 0.00, so the account closes.
